data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Pinnacle Holdings’ most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in HWBK and SBFG.

HWBK completed an acquisition or disposition of assets in an 8-K Item 2.01 filing on September 4, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/893847/000089384726000091/hwbk-20260903.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
